messages.text: For a Aerospace / Defense use case involving radar, where would Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fit in the test workflow?

### Short answer
The supported placement is for wireless communications testing around the DUT: signaling for establishing LTE/NR/WLAN connections and RF/application/mobility testing, and non-signaling/GPRF for waveform replay/creation or standalone TX measurement during R&D/debug verification [1][2][4][49].
### Workflow placement
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar / electromagnetic measurement workflow | The passages identify radar signature evaluation and electromagnetic measurements as radar-related test areas, but they do not identify a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the radar measurement instrument [30]. | MVG is described as providing antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation, and electromagnetic measurements [30]. |
| Aerospace / airborne RF susceptibility context | The passages frame radar as an external RF radiator that can affect airborne equipment, but they do not place a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in that radar susceptibility test itself [16]. | DO-160 Section 20 RF susceptibility covers EUT exposure to RF modulated power, including emissions from external radiators such as radar stations [16]. |
| Communications-link testing on the DUT | A signaling tester fits when the Aerospace / Defense DUT also has cellular or WLAN communications that need network emulation, DUT connection, RF testing, mobility testing, application testing, or OTA signaling testing [1][2][4][93]. | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, and WLAN signaling / measurements [4]. |
| OTA communications testing in antenna systems | CMX500 OBT fits in an OTA signaling workflow when integrated with MVG WaveStudio and MVG antenna / multiprobe measurement systems for 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests [22][93]. | MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing lets MVG antenna / multiprobe measurement systems directly execute 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests [93]. |
| Non-signaling R&D / debug | Non-signaling fits as a waveform and RF debug utility, using CMX500 GPRF to generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement [49]. | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a CMX500 non-signaling use case for waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement [49]. |
| IQ capture / replay loop | Non-signaling can support an IQ capture-to-replay loop, because the IQ recorder can record up to 4 Gbyte, save `.wv` files for replay, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [51]. | The IQ recorder records up to 4 Gbyte, saves `.wv` for replay, and uses the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [51]. |
| RF pre-conformance before certification | For cellular RF behavior, CMX500 fits early R&D / design verification before formal device certification, not as a radar certification workflow [34][36]. | RF pre-conformance testing is design verification in early product development before formal device certification, and the CMX500 WebGUI solution executes selected 5G NR FR1 SA test cases [34][36]. |
### Practical interpretation
【推論】For an Aerospace / Defense radar project, place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester beside the radar workflow as a communications-DUT tester, while radar signature evaluation, radar-station RF susceptibility, and broader EME effects remain separate radar / EMC / EME test areas [16][30][49][93].
【推論】Use signaling mode when the DUT must attach to emulated LTE / NR / WLAN networks or run OTA communications tests, because the cited CMX500 evidence is about network emulation, signaling, RF/application testing, and OTA signaling rather than radar echo generation [1][4][22][93].
【推論】Use non-signaling mode during R&D/debug when the need is generic RF waveform generation, IQ replay, or standalone TX measurement, because the cited non-signaling evidence is GPRF waveform replay / creation and IQ recording rather than radar-target simulation [49][51].

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

CMX500 Callbox › Callbox 定位
依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to set up。
- Easy to get in a call。
- Easy to test with。
- Focus on [[RF Testing]]，including [[3GPP pre-conformance]]。

來源以 [[Device Under Test]]、cell tower 與 smartphone 圖示描述 [[R&S CMX500]] 作為 DUT 連線與測試環境的中心。

CMX500 Callbox › Example Callbox use cases
[[CMX500_Callbox]] 的 Example Callbox use cases 進一步列出：

- R&D verification of new bands。
- Sensitivity testing。
- [[RedCap]]。
- [[CMX500 Desense Testing]]。
- [[3GPP Pre-Conformance Testing]]。
- [[CMX500 SRS RF measurements]]。
- UL MIMO and UL CA RF measurements。
- UL TX Switching。
- [[CMX500 Multi-SIM testing]]。
- High e2e TP testing。
- Non-signaling verification。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

R&S CMX500 › mmWave extension 與 remote radio heads
[[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]] 指出 3GPP FR2 frequency range 測試可由 [[R&S CMX500]] 搭配 [[R&S CMXHEAD30]]、[[R&S CMXHEAD50]] 或 [[R&S CMXHEAD50-Evo]] 執行。Remote radio head 是獨立 compact unit，在 IF 與 5G NR FR2 frequency ranges 間執行 upconversion / downconversion。CMX500 與 remote radio head 的 split concept 可在 5G NR FR2 frequency range 使用短 RF cable lengths，以最佳化 radiated chamber test environments 的 link budget。

適用 radiated chamber test environments：[[R&S CMQ500]] shielding cube 與 [[R&S ATS800R]] CATR rack based antenna test system。

R&S CMX500

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 defense tool
來源整理多個 defense-oriented use cases：

- jamming detection and classification。
- GPS spoofing detection。
- UAV IDS。
- signal source identification。
- RF emitter localization。
- passive RF monitoring。
- counter-UAV detection and mitigation。

SDR-assisted UAV security › SDR 作為 attack / test tool
來源明確指出 SDR technology 也可能削弱 security measures：

- 可執行 GPS spoofing attacks。
- 可產生 counterfeit GPS / GNSS signals。
- 可發射 jamming signals。
- 可用於 penetration testing，以檢查 UAV-based nodes 的 attack surface。

例如：

- [67] 使用 [[BladeRF x40]]、sensor data 與 NMEA messages 產生 mobile spoofing system，使 target GPS receivers 計算錯誤位置並被導向 designated landing areas。
- [68] 使用 [[DJI Spark]]、[[Parrot Bebop 2 FPV]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，測試 barrage jamming、tone jamming、protocol-aware congestion 等 interference techniques；protocol-aware jamming 被描述為最有前景。
- [69] 使用 [[DJI Phantom 3 Standard]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]] 建立 low-cost SDR-based portable anti-UAV system，具 detection、jamming、spoofing GPS signals 能力。

SDR-assisted UAV security › GPS spoofing / jamming detection
來源指出 affordable SDR devices，如 [[HackRF One]]、[[BladeRF 2.0]] 與 [[BladeRF x40]]，可用於 GNSS spoofing / jamming attacks，也可用於測試 defense mechanisms：

- [62] 提出 lightweight LSTM-based detection model，並以 knowledge distillation 壓縮，利於整合進 UAV control systems。
- [63] 研究 [[HackRF One]] 1.0 與 external TCXO 對 GNSS signal spoofing / jamming threats 的影響；受測 UAV GNSS receivers 包含 3DR IRIS+、Tarot 650 v2.2、DJI Inspire、Sky Hunter。
- [64] [[MAVIDS]] 使用 PCA 與 one-class classifiers，並以 [[HackRF One]]、[[GPS-SDR-SIM]] 與 [[GNU Radio Companion]] 進行 GPS spoofing / jamming experiments；macro-averaged F1 scores 為 GPS spoofing 90.57%、jamming 94.3%。
- [66] 使用 cellular BS 與 Wi-Fi AP crowd-sourced information 進行 GPS spoofing detection / mitigation，並以 [[HackRF One]] + TCXO 產生 spoofing signals。

answer.text:
### Short answer
The supported placement is for wireless communications testing around the DUT: signaling for establishing LTE/NR/WLAN connections and RF/application/mobility testing, and non-signaling/GPRF for waveform replay/creation or standalone TX measurement during R&D/debug verification [1][2][4][49].
### Workflow placement
| Workflow area | Where Signaling / Non-signaling Tester fits | Supported evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Radar / electromagnetic measurement workflow | The passages identify radar signature evaluation and electromagnetic measurements as radar-related test areas, but they do not identify a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester as the radar measurement instrument [30]. | MVG is described as providing antenna characterization, radar signature evaluation, and electromagnetic measurements [30]. |
| Aerospace / airborne RF susceptibility context | The passages frame radar as an external RF radiator that can affect airborne equipment, but they do not place a Signaling / Non-signaling Tester in that radar susceptibility test itself [16]. | DO-160 Section 20 RF susceptibility covers EUT exposure to RF modulated power, including emissions from external radiators such as radar stations [16]. |
| Communications-link testing on the DUT | A signaling tester fits when the Aerospace / Defense DUT also has cellular or WLAN communications that need network emulation, DUT connection, RF testing, mobility testing, application testing, or OTA signaling testing [1][2][4][93]. | CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement solution for LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, and WLAN signaling / measurements [4]. |
| OTA communications testing in antenna systems | CMX500 OBT fits in an OTA signaling workflow when integrated with MVG WaveStudio and MVG antenna / multiprobe measurement systems for 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests [22][93]. | MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing lets MVG antenna / multiprobe measurement systems directly execute 5G NR, RedCap, LTE, and WLAN OTA signaling tests [93]. |
| Non-signaling R&D / debug | Non-signaling fits as a waveform and RF debug utility, using CMX500 GPRF to generate ARB, CW, dual tone, or replay `.wv` waveforms for R&D waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement [49]. | CMX500 GPRF Generator is described as a CMX500 non-signaling use case for waveform replay / creation and standalone TX measurement [49]. |
| IQ capture / replay loop | Non-signaling can support an IQ capture-to-replay loop, because the IQ recorder can record up to 4 Gbyte, save `.wv` files for replay, and use the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [51]. | The IQ recorder records up to 4 Gbyte, saves `.wv` for replay, and uses the same IQ stream plus RF parameters as signaling [51]. |
| RF pre-conformance before certification | For cellular RF behavior, CMX500 fits early R&D / design verification before formal device certification, not as a radar certification workflow [34][36]. | RF pre-conformance testing is design verification in early product development before formal device certification, and the CMX500 WebGUI solution executes selected 5G NR FR1 SA test cases [34][36]. |
### Practical interpretation
【推論】For an Aerospace / Defense radar project, place the Signaling / Non-signaling Tester beside the radar workflow as a communications-DUT tester, while radar signature evaluation, radar-station RF susceptibility, and broader EME effects remain separate radar / EMC / EME test areas [16][30][49][93].
【推論】Use signaling mode when the DUT must attach to emulated LTE / NR / WLAN networks or run OTA communications tests, because the cited CMX500 evidence is about network emulation, signaling, RF/application testing, and OTA signaling rather than radar echo generation [1][4][22][93].
【推論】Use non-signaling mode during R&D/debug when the need is generic RF waveform generation, IQ replay, or standalone TX measurement, because the cited non-signaling evidence is GPRF waveform replay / creation and IQ recording rather than radar-target simulation [49][51].

CMX500 Callbox
[[CMX500 Callbox]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 簡報中對 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 use-case 定位：用一台 callbox 快速建立 DUT 連線，進行 RF、mobility、application、NTN、WLAN / cellular desense、pre-conformance 與 non-signaling R&D 驗證。

依 [[CMX500_Callbox]]，callbox 的核心敘事是：

- Easy to test with。

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

DO-160 airborne equipment EMC testing › Section 20 — Radio Frequency Susceptibility
來源說此測試確保 EUT exposed to a level of RF modulated power 時不受影響，並分為：

- Conducted Susceptibility（low freq）。
- Radiated Susceptibility（high freq）。

來源說 emissions can come from equipment installed inside aircraft as well as external radiators such as radar stations；Conducted Susceptibility similar to [[CS114]] test，Radiated Susceptibility similar to [[RS103]]。

MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing › 測試架構
依 [[MVG integrates CMX500 OBT into WaveStudio Software Suite, simplifying 5G OTA signaling test processes]]：

- [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 被整合到 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 控制 / 串接 [[MVG]] antenna measurement systems。
- 與 [[MVG]] multi-probe measurement systems 搭配時，來源稱可進行 precise OTA testing under real-world conditions。
- 目標是 streamlining test environment，簡化 next-generation wireless devices 的 OTA signaling testing processes。

依 [[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]]：

- [[MVG]] 已將 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] of the [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]。
- Manufacturers 可在 single antenna measurement system 內執行 comprehensive 4G、5G 與 [[WLAN]] [[OTA testing]]。
- [[WaveStudio Software Suite]] 整合 full Wi‑Fi（[[IEEE 802.11]] a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be）access point and station testing functionality。
- Software now supports [[5G NR Non-Standalone]]（[[EN-DC]]）testing with the [[R&S CMX500]]。
- [[MVG]] multiprobe measurement systems 被描述為 fully support Wi‑Fi and cellular standards within a single tester。

RF pre-conformance testing › 來源定義
依 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]]（06.2025）：

- 5G NR UE 上市前需要通過符合 [[3GPP]] specifications 的 device certification。
- [[RF pre-conformance testing]] 又稱 design verification。
- RF pre-conformance testing 應在產品開發早期開始，用於及早找出並處理問題，減少延遲並提升最終產品品質。
- [[R&S CMX500]] 3GPP RF pre-conformance WebGUI solution 提供執行 **NR-FR1 Standalone（SA）** test cases 的平台，依據 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] specification。
- Manual verification capabilities 適合 early-stage validation、debugging 與 step-by-step verification。
- Test case procedures 針對 R&D use cases 最佳化，使用 specification 中最相關的 configurations。

RF pre-conformance testing
[[RF pre-conformance testing]] 是在正式 device certification / conformance testing 前，於研發早期對 RF 行為進行的 design verification；在 [[1C111_1e_3GPPPreConfGuide]] 中，它指 [[R&S CMX500]] 依 [[3GPP TS 38.521-1]] 執行 selected 5G NR FR1 SA pre-conformance test cases 的 WebGUI workflow。

CMX500 GPRF Generator
[[CMX500 GPRF Generator]] 是 [[CMX500_Callbox]] 中的 [[R&S CMX500]] non-signaling use case：在 CMX500 上產生 ARB、CW、dual tone 或 replay `.wv` waveform，支援 R&D waveform replay / creation 與 standalone TX measurement 工作流。

CMX500 GPRF Generator › IQ recorder
來源稱 IQ recorder 可：

- Record up to 4 Gbyte to a file。
- Save files as `.wv` for replay。
- Use the same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling。
- As many instances as supported by CMX hardware。
- 2 per RFU。
- 1 per IFU。
- FR1 specialist：8 instances in parallel。
- Inspect the recorded trace directly in GUI。

MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing
[[MVG CMX500 OBT OTA signaling testing]] 是 [[MVG]] 與 [[Rohde & Schwarz]] 新聞稿中描述的整合測試情境：將 [[R&S CMX500 OBT]] 整合進 [[MVG]] 的 [[WaveStudio Software Suite]]，讓 [[MVG]] antenna / multiprobe measurement systems 可直接執行 [[5G NR]]、[[RedCap]]、[[LTE]] 與 [[WLAN]] OTA signaling tests。[[MVG OTA test systems now support full WLAN OTA signaling testing alongside cellular coverage with CMX500 OBT from Rohde & Schwarz]] 將此情境擴充到 full [[WLAN]] signaling test functionality including [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]]。
